neighbours.label: the token ' too' / 'Too' itself, in either sense (excess 'too hot' or additive 'me too'); not the idea of excess without the word
neighbours.notes: Layer-0 token detector. Probes: additive 'too' fires as strongly as excessive 'too'; excess without the word (overly, excessively, way more) stays below 0.2; look-alikes (to, two, tooth, Toothpaste) and all-caps 'TOO' (different tokenization) are silent. Inverse solver (differential evolution over a 38-sentence bank) found no leak; near-miss ceiling 0.20 on ' overly'. Strongest feeder of L5/N4199+ (play step drop 0.32).
